name: Deduplicate Compare Conflict Resolution Import
description: Reuse saved conflict-resolution decisions when creating a new compare project, dedupe matching decisions, skip conflicting or ambiguous imports, and show structured warnings without failing project creation.

userStories.title: Enrich import source and target metadata
userStories.description: As a developer, I want conflict-resolution import planning to receive source project, source article, and target article details so skipped imports can produce actionable warnings without extra queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend `ComparisonProjectConflictResolutionImportSourceRow` and its SQL to include `sourceComparisonProjectId`, `sourceComparisonProjectName`, `sourceResolutionId`, `sourceArticleId`, `sourceExternalArticleId`, `sourceArticleTitle`, `resolutionValue`, and DOI keys.
Join the selected source conflict-resolution rows to their comparison project and article metadata while still starting from selected rows in `app.comparison_project_conflict_resolution`.
Extend DOI target article query results to include target article title and external article ID instead of returning `NULL` for those fields.
Merge DOI and ID/title target rows by target article ID without losing DOI, title, external article ID, or conflict-resolution eligibility data.
Update helper tests to assert the source-row SQL includes project metadata and the DOI target SQL exposes target title and external article ID fields.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.test.ts` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Plan imports with warning-backed matching skips
userStories.description: As a developer, I want ambiguous target matching and duplicate eligible target keys to become structured warnings so importable resolutions can continue while unsafe source rows are skipped.
acceptanceCriteria: Change the import planner output to include `candidates`, `warnings`, `skippedRows`, and `skipCounts` split by reason.
Represent `ambiguous-target-match` warnings with source rows, target articles, match kind, match key, compare project name, compare project ID, article IDs, article titles, and resolution answers.
Evaluate target ambiguity against conflict-resolution eligible target articles; ineligible target matches only contribute to `skippedNotConflicting` when no eligible target can be chosen.
Prefer a unique DOI match over ID/title and do not use ID/title to override a unique DOI match.
When DOI matches multiple eligible target articles, use ID/title only if it uniquely picks one of those DOI-matched articles.
When the source has DOI keys, do not use ID/title to match a target article with a different DOI unless ID/title is selecting within ambiguous DOI matches.
Duplicate eligible target DOI or ID/title keys that cannot resolve to one eligible article are skipped with `ambiguous-target-match` warnings instead of hard errors.
Source rows with no usable key, no target match, or a non-conflicting target still skip without warnings.
Add helper tests for ambiguous DOI resolved by ID/title, ambiguous DOI without tie-breaker, duplicate eligible target key warning, no usable key, no target match, and not-conflicting target skips.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.test.ts` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Dedupe agreed decisions and warn on conflicting values
userStories.description: As a developer, I want matched import rows grouped by target article so identical decisions import once, conflicting decisions skip with warnings, and invalid answers do not block safe imports.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate uniquely matched eligible source values before target conflict grouping.
If a source value maps to exactly one target summary option, use the canonical target option value for import and grouping.
If a source value is outside target summary options, skip that source row with an `invalid-target-resolution-value` warning.
Group remaining valid source rows by resolved target article.
Duplicate source DOI keys with the same normalized value dedupe and import once.
Duplicate source ID/title keys with the same normalized value dedupe and import once.
Multiple source compare projects resolving the same target article with the same value dedupe and import once.
Duplicate source keys or multiple source compare projects resolving the same target article with different values skip that target resolution with a `conflicting-resolution-values` warning.
Planner summary details count `deduped`, `skippedAmbiguousTarget`, `skippedConflicting`, `skippedInvalidValue`, `skippedNoUsableKey`, `skippedNoTargetMatch`, and `skippedNotConflicting` consistently.
The sum of `imported + deduped + skipped` equals `scanned`, and `skipped` equals the sum of all skipped detail fields.

Add helper tests for duplicate source DOI same-value dedupe, duplicate source ID/title same-value dedupe, duplicate source key conflicting-value warning, same-target same-value dedupe, same-target conflicting-value warning, and invalid source value warning.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.test.ts` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Return non-fatal import warnings from create route
userStories.description: As a user creating a compare project, I want project creation to succeed when selected conflict-resolution imports include skipped warnings so safe imported rows are still saved.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep configuration errors as blocking `400` responses before import starts: Summary mode disabled, Compare with humans disabled, Allow conflict resolution disabled, missing source, archived source, source disallows conflict resolution, non-summary source, or source with no saved resolutions.
Do not throw for warning-only import conflicts from the planner.
Create the compare project and safe imported rows in one transaction.
Insert only safe candidates into `app.comparison_project_conflict_resolution` and count `imported` as inserted rows, not scanned source rows.
Return `{data, conflictResolutionImportSummary}` whenever import sources were selected, including warnings when zero rows were imported.

Response warnings include compare project names, compare project IDs, source article titles, source article IDs, target article titles when known, target article IDs when known, resolution answers, match keys, and match kinds.
Route tests cover successful creation when one imported resolution conflicts and is skipped.
Route tests cover safe resolutions still being inserted when other selected resolutions warn.
Route tests cover summary counts including `deduped`, `skippedAmbiguousTarget`, `skippedConflicting`, and `skippedInvalidValue`.
Route tests cover configuration errors returning `400` and leaving no compare project row.
`bun test src/server/routes/comparisonProjectsRoutes/comparisonProjectConflictResolutionImport.test.ts` passes.
`bun test src/server/routes/ComparisonProjectsRoutes.rollback.test.ts` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.

userStories.title: Preserve create-from-project import summary in client service
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I want the create-from-project service to return the created compare project and optional import summary so the UI can display server warnings after a successful create.
acceptanceCriteria: Add client-side types for `ConflictResolutionImportWarning` and `ConflictResolutionImportSummary` in `src/services/comparisonProjectsService.ts`.

Type warning source rows with compare project ID, compare project name, source resolution ID, source article ID, source external article ID, source article title, resolution value, match kind, and match key.
Type warning target articles with target article ID, target external article ID, and target article title.
Update `createComparisonProjectFromProject` so it does not discard top-level `conflictResolutionImportSummary` when unwrapping the API response.
Return a typed value that preserves both `data` and optional `conflictResolutionImportSummary` for create-from-project callers.
Adjust existing create-from-project callers and tests for the new service return shape.
`bun test src/app/routes/+compare-judgments/-+create-from-project.vitest.tsx` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run desktop:build` passes because shared service types changed.

userStories.title: Show post-create import warnings in the create UI
userStories.description: As a user creating a compare project, I want skipped import warnings shown after successful creation so I know which prior decisions were not reused and why.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace the hard-stop import warning copy with `Matching duplicate decisions are imported once. Conflicting or ambiguous decisions are skipped and reported after creation.`
When creation succeeds without import warnings, preserve the existing immediate navigation to `/compare-judgments`.
When creation succeeds with import warnings, keep the user on `src/app/routes/+compare-judgments/+create-from-project.tsx` and render a post-create confirmation/warning panel.
The post-create panel links to the created compare project and to the compare-project list.
The warning panel lists the skip reason, compare project name and ID, source article title and ID, target article title and ID when known, resolution answer, match key, and match kind when useful.
Blocking configuration failures still render as form errors and do not show the post-create warning panel.
The create page still sends selected `conflictResolutionImportSourceComparisonProjectIds`.

UI tests cover warning copy, selected import source submission, server import warning rendering with project/article/value details, successful creation with warnings staying on the create page, successful creation without warnings navigating to `/compare-judgments`, and blocking validation errors staying on the form.
`bun test src/app/routes/+compare-judgments/-+create-from-project.vitest.tsx` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
Browser flow is verified with `bun run dev:server` and `bun run dev:app` by creating a compare project with selected import sources that include both deduped and conflicting resolutions.
`bun run desktop:build` passes because UI route behavior changed.
